description: Vic and Ron tour the everyday side of the Extropy Engine: the overlay apps, the till, and what it feels like when your price drops at checkout. No jargon, no whitepaper, just the experience of living inside a system where contribution earns its keep. Part 1 of The Engine in Plain Words, the four-part series that explains the whole machine in plain spoken language.
